en.html:
Suddenly the passage ended. A wide space opened before us, and at the far end stood a sanctuary much like the one aboveground.

The Lower Shrine.

...This far I had come. Now the decision also had to arrive.

en.html:
Moriuji"A golden god sleeps beneath the earth... and when the time of summons comes, will appear in our world."
Moriuji"An Emishi belief, was it not?"
Muramasa"............"
Moriuji"What do you think?"
Kageaki"...Sir?"
Moriuji"This belief that a god lives underground. All this trouble taken to build a sanctuary beneath the earth... perhaps such fantastic legends are not entirely fit for laughing away."
Moriuji"Would you not agree?"
Kageaki"Indeed, sir. Precisely as you say."
Moriuji"Huhuhu..."
Kageaki"...?"
Moriuji"This shrine's priest you are, no? A layman's notions you swallow so obediently, not one word of your own. Your professional standing, where will it go?"
Kageaki"...I am ashamed, sir."
Moriuji"If you have an opinion, let us hear it."
Kageaki"............Then, with your permission."
Moriuji"Granted."
Kageaki"According to one theory, Hachiman was originally a god brought from overseas... Therefore, as a guardian of people seeking a new land also, he is understood."
Moriuji"Oh...?"
Kageaki"That aspect of the Hachiman faith, perhaps this is how it has been given form."
Moriuji"The Lower Shrine, built in this other space underground, represents the new world Hachiman brings. That is your meaning?"
Kageaki"Indeed."
Moriuji"As expected of a professional. You know your subject well."
Kageaki"Such shallow learning I have paraded before Your Excellency. The embarrassment is entirely mine, sir."

ja.html:
護氏「金色の神は地の底に眠り…… 　いつか招きの時が来たならば、我らの世へ 現れると」
護氏「蝦夷どもの信仰であったかな」
村正「…………」
護氏「どう思う」
景明「……はっ？」
護氏「地の底に神在りとする信仰よ。 　かような祭殿がわざわざ地下に建てられて あるを見れば……荒唐無稽な伝承もあながち 笑い捨てにしたものではないやもしれぬ」
護氏「そう思わぬか」
景明「はっ。 　御意にございます」
護氏「ふっふふ……」
景明「……？」
護氏「貴様はこの社の神官ではないか。 　素人考えを諾々と容いれ、一言も申さずでは、 立場に関わろう」
景明「……畏れ入ります」
護氏「意見あらば、言うてみよ」
景明「…………では。 　お許しを得まして」
護氏「うむ」
景明「一説によりますれば、八幡神の原本は渡来 の神であり…… 　従って、新しき国を求める人々の守護神と いう性格が存在するとか」
護氏「ほう……」
景明「その八幡信仰が、かような形で表現された ……とも考えられますかと」
護氏「地下という異空間に造られた下宮は、八幡 神がもたらす新世界を象徴するもの。 　そういう事か」
景明「御意」
護氏「流石に本職。 　良く存じておるのう」
景明「御前にて浅学をひけらかし、汗顔の至りで ございます」

For one moment my blood had gone cold, but...

Through it I had got, perhaps?

Moriuji"There you have slipped."
Kageaki"————"
Moriuji"Answering back, or anything resembling it, you should not have attempted. A real priest, however much I invited him, would only have shrunk into himself. Not one word."
Kageaki"...Forgive my discourtesy—"
Moriuji"But the more fatal mistake was in your walking, all the way down here... that distance you were keeping."
Moriuji"A mere priest knows exactly where my sword can reach, and naturally keeps himself just outside? Such talented priests we do not have."
Kageaki"!!"

Moriuji"So Prince Maidono has a fighting man like you under him also."
Kageaki"..."
Moriuji"This assassination work you accepted out of loyalty? Or did the reward do the persuading?"
Kageaki"..."
Moriuji"Now silence you are choosing? Too late, my little bird. Chirp something."
Kageaki"...Then I have a question for the Grand Commander of the Six Guards."
Moriuji"Oh? The assassin proposes to question me?"
Kageaki"One question there is which a ruler must answer. Whoever asks it, that makes no difference."
Moriuji"Speak."
Kageaki"What kind of king are you?"
Moriuji"————"
Kageaki"With Yamato, what do you intend to do? With its people, what do you intend to do?"
Kageaki"What kind of king are you? ...I ask for your answer."
Moriuji"Huh, huh."
Kageaki"..."
Moriuji"Your bad luck, assassin. For that question I have no answer."
Kageaki"What?"
Moriuji"A conqueror I am. Nothing else."
Moriuji"Everything I take. Everything I conquer. Everything I make submit. Moriuji Ashikaga means this."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Then simply being master is your aim? Governing the country, that does not interest you?"
Moriuji"Not that there is no interest. For further conquest it is a useful means... Only that."

ja.html:
護氏「舞殿宮の下にも貴様のような武人がいたか」
景明「……」
護氏「刺客の任を受けたは忠義からか？ 　それとも褒賞に釣られたか？」
景明「……」
護氏「今更だんまりを決め込んでも遅かろう。 　何か囀ってみよ」
景明「……ならば。 　六衛大将領殿下にお尋ねする」
護氏「ほゥ？ 　刺客が、予に問いを投げるか」
景明「王将たる者には、相手が何人であろうとも 答えねばならぬ問いが一つきりある」
護氏「云うが良い」
景明「貴方は如何なる王者か」
護氏「――――」
景明「この大和を如何にされる存念か。 　国民くにたみを如何にされる存念か」
景明「貴方は如何なる王なのか。 　……御答を賜りたい」
護氏「ふっ、ふ」
景明「……」
護氏「生憎であったな、刺客。 　予はその問いに答を持たぬ」
景明「何と？」
護氏「予は偏ひとえに覇者」
護氏「全てを奪い、征服し、従える……。 　それが足利護氏よ」
景明「…………」
景明「では貴方は……統べる・・・だけが目的だという のか。 　治めることに関心はないと？」
護氏「皆無、とは云わぬが。 　征服を進める手段よの……所詮」

He did not want to be master so that he could govern the country.

He governed the country so that he could become its absolute master...!

Kageaki"Then your purpose has already been achieved?"
Moriuji"Hmph... Nonsense you are talking. Satisfied, why would I be?"
Moriuji"Even now in Yamato, fellows who do not bow to Rokuhara's banner are strolling about in broad daylight. As though the place belongs to their fathers."
Kageaki"...The occupation forces?"
Moriuji"Until I drive them out, my conquest is not complete."
Kageaki"You intend to open hostilities eventually..."
Moriuji"Eventually? Such leisurely business I am not proposing. Immediately."
Moriuji"I will not let those white swine fatten in my garden any longer. Back to their pens across the sea with them."
Kageaki"You cannot expect to win."
Moriuji"I will win."
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
Moriuji"Six years ago, different matter. Whatever I did, no chance of victory was there. Submission I chose for that reason."
Moriuji"But today's Rokuhara is not that Rokuhara. This time we can win. The land may be devastated, half the people may be sacrificed—but victory we shall have!"
Kageaki"...Madness."
Moriuji"Hm...?"
Kageaki"Half the people? Arre, what meaning is left in victory after paying that price!"
Kageaki"Even if you drive the occupation forces out, Yamato itself will collapse..."
Moriuji"Very likely."
Kageaki"...!?"
Moriuji"No matter."
Kageaki"Nothing will remain, and still this victory you want?"
Moriuji"It will remain. The fact that I conquered Yamato. That cannot collapse with the country."
Kageaki"............"
Moriuji"After that, what happens is not a subject of interest to me."
Kageaki"Grand Commander... You would... for that alone—"

護氏「しかし今の六波羅は昔日のそれではない。 　今度は勝てる……国土は荒れ、民の半分は 犠牲となるやもしれんが、必ず勝つ！」
景明「……馬鹿な」
護氏「ふん……？」
景明「民の半分？ 　そこまでの犠牲を払っての勝利など、何の 意味もない！」
景明「例え進駐軍を撤退せしめても、大和は自ら 崩壊する……」
護氏「で、あろうのぅ」
景明「……!?」
護氏「構わぬ」
景明「何も残らぬ勝利をあえて欲する――と？」
護氏「残るとも。 　予が大和を制覇したという事実はな」
景明「…………」
護氏「その後の事に興味は無い」
景明「大将領…… 　貴方は……それだけのために」
ja.text:
護氏「六年前とは違う。あの時は如何にしようと
勝つ目が無かった。
　だから恭順の道を選んだ」護氏「しかし今の六波羅は昔日のそれではない。
　今度は勝てる……国土は荒れ、民の半分は
犠牲となるやもしれんが、必ず勝つ！」景明「……馬鹿な」護氏「ふん……？」景明「民の半分？
　そこまでの犠牲を払っての勝利など、何の
意味もない！」景明「例え進駐軍を撤退せしめても、大和は自ら
崩壊する……」護氏「で、あろうのぅ」景明「……!?」護氏「構わぬ」景明「何も残らぬ勝利をあえて欲する――と？」護氏「残るとも。
　予が大和を制覇したという事実はな」景明「…………」護氏「その後の事に興味は無い」景明「大将領……
　貴方は……それだけのために」

en.html:
Moriuji"Chalo. Enough time we have wasted on trivial matters."
Moriuji"For your journey to the other world, perhaps I have given rather generous provisions. No matter... One more honor I shall give you also."
Moriuji"Higekiri!"
